notes.title: New trailer and song release
notes.notes:
This week, all gaming retinas are focused on Cologne and Gamescom, and Den of Wolves was highlighted in two showcases – [b]The Future Games Show[/b] and [b]The Level Infinite Showcase.[/b].

[previewyoutube=_CJsG9kZWI0;full][/previewyoutube]

In the clip from Level Infinite, you hear directly from Ulf Andersson and Simon Viklund about our focus on immersion, avoiding elements that remind players "this is just a game," and drawing inspiration from films like [i]Inception[/i] and[i] The Matrix[/i] for alternate reality concepts. In addition to that, The Future Games Show trailer shows you additional gameplay. 

[previewyoutube=FkXoeYCf8Z0;full][/previewyoutube]

To top it off, Simon Viklund released the full song featured in the trailer - “Logic Bomb” is [url=https://ditto.fm/logic-bomb]out now on all streaming platforms[/url].
